data.narrative:
Cognichip is a Series A-stage semiconductor company that has raised $93M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 11 private and public peers in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including public benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and private companies such as SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient depth in same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrowly-defined semiconductor frontier-tech cohort. Instead, stage-progression methodology was applied, using the $93M total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to subsequent rounds. This yields an implied valuation of $186M.

The triangulated valuation range is $158M (low) to $214M (high), with a median of $186M supported by the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the limited peer dataset for direct comparison, the reliance on a standardized step-up multiplier absent company-specific profitability or revenue metrics, and broader semiconductor market volatility affecting private multiples. A more granular valuation would require additional financial performance data or a larger cohort of comparable-stage transactions in the frontier-chip space.
